label: Sizes
description: Footprint seen from above, measured in soldiers. Sets the hitbox and readability.

terms.label: Tiny
terms.description: Smaller than one soldier: dogs, small drones. Hard to hit, easy to lose sight of.

terms.label: Small
terms.description: One soldier: infantry and power-suit troopers.

terms.label: Medium
terms.description: Two to three soldier-widths: buggies, cars, light walkers, IFVs.

terms.label: Huge
terms.description: Two tanks or more: super-heavies, giant mechs, airships.
